messages.subject: Edit data.frame from reactive object!
parts:
Hi!

I would like to edit a table, more'm having difficulty. For exemplo:

 runApp(list(
   ui=pageWithSidebar(headerPanel("Adding entries to table"),
                  sidebarPanel(textInput("text1", "Column 1"),
                               textInput("text2", "Column 2"),
                               actionButton("update", "Update Table")),
                  mainPanel(tableOutput("table1"))),
 server=function(input, output, session) {
 values <- reactiveValues()
 values$df <- data.frame(Column1 = 10, Column2 = 5) # pay attention!
 newEntry <- observe({
   if(input$update > 0) {
     isolate(values$df[1,1] <- isolate(input$text1))
     isolate(values$df[1,2] <- isolate(input$text2)) 
   }
 })
 output$table1 <- renderTable({values$df})
 }))     

It's working! But, if I make

dados <- reactive({  read.table('test.txt')  })

values$df <- dados() # renderTable({dados()}), observe(dados()), isolate(dados()), none worked! 

It's not working! What am I doing wrong?
